tools.name: search_surf_spots
tools.description: Use this when the person names a surf spot, a town or a country and you need the spot's id. country is a two-letter code (PT) to keep to one country. Not for spots near a place: use list_surf_spots_near. Answers surf spots whose name, town, area or country match the words in any order, plurals, case

tools.name: list_surf_spots_near
tools.description: Use this when the person asks what surf spots are around a place or around them. Give near (a town, area or spot name) or lat and lon. Not for where the surf is best: use find_best_surf. Answers the nearest surf spots to a spot, town or area named in near, or to lat and lon: each with its distance i

tools.name: find_best_surf
tools.description: Use this when the person asks where or when to surf around a place. when is in the person's words (tomorrow morning, Saturday, this weekend); default the next 24 hours. Not for one spot's full hours: use get_surf_forecast. Answers surf spots near the place, ranked for the time asked (today, tomorrow

tools.name: get_surf_forecast
tools.description: Use this when the person asks about the waves, wind or conditions at one spot. Not for comparing spots: use find_best_surf. Not for tides: use get_tide_times. Answers one spot's forecast: now, its next good window, each of the next days (at most 16) with its best hours, and hour by hour the wave hei

tools.name: get_tide_times
tools.description: Use this when the person asks about the tide at a spot. Not for waves or wind: use get_surf_forecast. Answers a spot's high and low tides for the coming days (at most 14) in its own time zone, with heights, worked out from the tide constants of the nearest station; says so where there is none.

tools.name: list_surf_schools
tools.description: Use this when the person asks for lessons, a board to rent or a surf shop near a spot. kind keeps to one: school, rental or shop. Not for the waves: use get_surf_forecast. Answers surf schools, board rentals and surf shops within 2 km of a spot, each with its name, kind, distance, address and link w

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Use this when the person asks to tell Supersurf something: a wrong forecast, a missing spot, an idea. Only their words, never include the conversation. Not for questions about the surf: answer from the other tools.
